name: KBBI
tagline: The official Indonesian dictionary, right on your phone
description:
KBBI is the Android app for Kamus Besar Bahasa Indonesia, the official comprehensive dictionary of the Indonesian language. Search for a word and get its official definitions straight from the source that Indonesian schools and dictionaries rely on.

It's a simple, no-fuss way to check spelling and meaning without digging through a physical dictionary or a cluttered website.
